_meta.description: Lifewarden subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: healing power, HoTs, thorns, HP regen.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la puissance de soin de 1.2% et les soins recus de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases healing power by 1.2% and healing received by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats d'epines de 1% et la valeur des boucliers de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases thorns damage by 1% and shield value by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les PV max de 1% et la regeneration de PV de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases max HP by 1% and HP regen by 0.5% per level.
